title: DevBoard — Developer Project & Task Tracker
desc: Workspace-scoped multi-tenant SaaS with role-based access control (owner/admin/member/guest) and per-project membership gating, enforced through a shared authorization layer across all controllers. Features an event-driven automation rule engine — configurable per-project triggers (task created, status changed, assignee added, due-date reached) firing async actions via queued jobs with a persisted execution log. Production-grade outbound webhook system: HMAC-SHA256 signed payloads, exponential-backoff retries (3 attempts, 30/120/300s), and a per-delivery audit record. GitHub integration with task-to-issue linking and inbound webhook sync that updates task state on PR merge. Pusher-based real-time updates with polling fallback; multi-stage Docker build and GitHub Actions CI running PHPUnit against a real Postgres service. Demo: demo@devboard.app / demo1234
